tools.description: What has this Japanese company or other filer submitted to EDINET in the last 365 days? From this service's day-by-day index of the EDINET document list: document ID, document type (EDINET code and English label, our translation), submission time, period, filer, issuer, tender offer subject and subs

tools.name: edinet_filing_relations
tools.description: How is this EDINET filing related to other filings, as EDINET's document list states explicitly? One hop each: parent document (parentDocID: amendment, change report base, withdrawal), child documents, filer, large shareholding issuer, tender offer subject and listed subsidiaries, plus FSA correctio

tools.name: edinet_holdings_tender_offers
tools.description: Which large shareholding and tender offer filings name this Japanese issuer? Large shareholding reports, change reports and amendments (EDINET issuerEdinetCode) and tender offer filings (subjectEdinetCode), newest first, from this service's EDINET index. Filer names are given only for organisations;

tools.name: edinet_large_holding_reports
tools.description: What holding ratios did large shareholding reports and change reports about this Japanese issuer state? Newest first, per report: each holder's ratio and the ratio stated for its previous report, shares held and outstanding, base date, obligation and filing dates, amended document, and the joint tot

tools.name: edinet_ownership_change_events
tools.description: Which large shareholdings in Japanese companies changed recently, across all issuers? One row per large shareholding report read from EDINET, newest first: issuer, holder (corporate names only), total ratio as filed and the previous total stated in it, and event types derived from those figures only

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 30 days after settlement.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
